name: houdini-mcp
description: Claude Code plugins for Houdini MCP (https://github.com/JuyeongYi/HoudiniMCP): the MCP server connection plus skills and subagents for each Houdini tool pack.

plugins.name: houdini-mcp
plugins.description: Connects to the Houdini MCP server and teaches the working rules for a live Houdini session (houdini_mcp).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-base
plugins.description: Visual review (snapshots, videos, A/B comparisons), scene debugging and a read-only scene auditor (houdini_mcp_base).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-sop
plugins.description: Procedural SOP modelling with measured before/after results (houdini_mcp_sop).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-vex
plugins.description: Writing and validating VEX wrangles with the vcc compiler (houdini_mcp_vex).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-mat
plugins.description: MaterialX look development, texture checks and assignments (houdini_mcp_mat).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-lop
plugins.description: Inspecting and editing composed USD stages in Solaris (houdini_mcp_lop).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-render
plugins.description: Checking, running and verifying renders by reading the result pixels (houdini_mcp_render).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-dop
plugins.description: Building DOP simulations directly, test runs, caching and debugging (houdini_mcp_dop).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-dop-rbd
plugins.description: RBD destruction setup and diagnosis of pieces and simulations (houdini_mcp_dop_rbd).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-rig
plugins.description: KineFX skeletons, skin weights and APEX rig graphs with validation (houdini_mcp_rig).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-chop
plugins.description: Analysing channels, loops, spikes, baking and audio (houdini_mcp_chop).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-io
plugins.description: Exporting and importing USD, Alembic, FBX and geometry with read-back verification (houdini_mcp_io).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-cop
plugins.description: Building Copernicus (COP) textures and checking them as images and numbers (houdini_mcp_cop).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-top
plugins.description: Cooking TOP (PDG) networks and debugging failed work items (houdini_mcp_top).

plugins.name: houdini-mcp-groom
plugins.description: Inspecting grooms and hair cards - strand statistics, groom chain wiring and card fit (houdini_mcp_groom).
